thread:
maria: heads-up — planning to merge raytrace streaming delta handling in ~30m. Quick compatibility question for tool/function calling: are clients allowed to receive tool_call events split across multiple delta messages (args arriving incrementally), or must a single delta contain the whole tool_call payload? We need to be explicit in contract so SDKs don't swallow partial args.

kevin: short answer: we currently stream partial func args as deltas (we flush tokens as generated). But we don't emit a final 'tool_call.complete' event today. Is that what you're planning to change?

maria: yes — new impl will emit incremental arg chunks and then a final event with "event":"tool_call.completed" and the canonical args JSON. The final event will also include a stable tool_entry_id.

sophie: important: what about clients that parse deltas as complete JSON each time? They'll break. We should add a 'partial': true flag on interim chunks and 'partial': false on final.

kevin: +1. Also recommend bumping the schema version in the streaming metadata so older SDKs can opt-out.

maria: proposal: interim deltas -> {"type":"tool_call.delta","tool":"<name>","partial":true,"content":"..."}
final -> {"type":"tool_call.complete","tool":"<name>","partial":false,"args":{...},"tool_entry_id":"xyz"}

maria: example of streaming chunks (pseudo):
```json
{"type":"tool_call.delta","tool":"price_lookup","partial":true,"content":"{\"product_id\": \"123"}
{"type":"tool_call.delta","tool":"price_lookup","partial":true,"content":" , \"currency\": \"USD\" }"}
{"type":"tool_call.complete","tool":"price_lookup","partial":false,"args":{"product_id":"123","currency":"USD"},"tool_entry_id":"abcd-1234"}
```

sophie: SDK action items: 1) treat delta.type==tool_call.delta as appendable stream 2) only deserialize args on tool_call.complete 3) expose incremental content as raw string for UI streaming.

kevin: what about embedded function params that include binary or base64? those need chunking rules — we should add 'chunk_index' and 'chunk_count' metadata.

maria: good catch. add optional fields: chunk_index (int), chunk_total (int).

deploybot: deploy scheduled at 17:45 UTC :rocket: — will run compatibility tests against canary SDKs (devx/canary-ink).

sophie: also flag for fallback: if client sees 'tool_call.complete' missing after N seconds, runtime should emit an error delta "tool_call.error" with reason.

kevin: agree. default N=5s for low-latency models, 15s for streaming long-form.

maria: I'll open a short PR to the spec and include the json examples + migration notes. cc @kevin @sophie. If no objections I'll merge after CI.

kevin: no objections. quick reminder to update the Chat contract doc in /docs/api/chat.md.

sophie: adding note: streaming schema version -> "streaming_schema": "v2" in initial connect meta.

maria: thanks — will include. :thumbsup:

kevin: ping me when PR is up, I'll review quickly.

maria: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4827 — tests passing on canary. Merging in 10.

sophie: great, will coordinate SDK patch.

deploybot: canary deploy started at 17:52 UTC. monitor logs in #eng-platform or /deploys/canary.

kevin: observed no error spikes in 10m smoke. partial arg handling looks clean. 

sophie: closing loop — SDKs updated to buffer deltas and surface final args only. thanks all.
